preregistration.rule: (1) keep v1 source PAs 1, 2, 9; (2) candidates = eval-set entries with labels.inning == 3, readability == 'readable', all ten field_status 'confirmed', cached frame passes bug_present (navy >= 0.3, top_line >= 0.6, panel_white <= 0.2), and each of the five DIGIT_FIELDS segments into as many glyphs as the label has digits; (3) keep only plate appearances with exactly one eval-set entry; (4) among those choose the one adding the fewest non-'0'/'3' glyphs, ties broken by earliest frame_seconds. PA 5/6 (balls=3) is never a source. Result: PA18/1 (t=1706.25).
preregistration.blindness: not 'frames unseen': the judge looked at bug crops of 9 candidate frames and computed only v1 gate values / glyph sizes; no glyph distances or v2 accuracy were computed before the rule was fixed. Report as 'rule fixed, then first-computed held-out'.

digit3_statistics.note: held-out glyphs whose verified label is 3 (inning=3 or balls=3), matched with v2 templates via src.vision.sny_scoreboard (normalise + per-digit min mean-abs distance); thresholds MAX_DISTANCE/MIN_MARGIN unchanged

note: Layout-specific template matcher for the SNY count bug of game 747139; not a general OCR and not automatic sync. Scores are on the verified eval set only.
